JOHANNESBURG

SEARCH:
[covered]

The bottom edge repeats JOHANNESBURG and 26°12'15"S 28°2'50"E upside down.

states.revealedText:
SEARCH:
Found JADE laboratory, mostly
abandoned. There is one holdout,
who offered to join us.

[icon: a laboratory flask labeled JADE]

JADE was set up to be a production facility to
create vast doses of a cure, if one had been
found. The equipment is still functional.
They would need a supply center and a sample
to start production.

Open the following doors if you haven't done so
already: 46  20
states.effect: Open doors 46 and 20 if they are not already open. The JADE laboratory text names a functional production facility that would need a supply center and a sample to start production. Those requirements are printed as findings, not as a separate action on this card.

rules: Blue Player card for Johannesburg. Not a port. No anchor on the compass.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face. State side A is the unchanged player-card back.
Scratching opens doors 46 and 20 if not already open, and reveals the JADE laboratory.
notes: Card id 10710. Scratch state card id 10723.
Printed code P7-11b stays on the scratched face.
Coordinates are printed 26°12'15"S 28°2'50"E, with a single digit in the minutes of longitude.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened. A second, non-search Johannesburg Player card is card 12.
The holdout who offered to join is not given a name on this card. Whatever they add is behind doors 46 and 20.
